pages.title: Settlement Tower
pages.text: Settlement Towers generate in plains, savannas, snowy plains, and taigas. They are the rarest and most heavily defended Illager settlement.

pages.title: Occupants
pages.text: Towers can contain common, strong, and very strong units. Evokers and Illusioners may occupy the strongest positions, along with compatible elite Illagers from installed mods.

pages.title: Loot
pages.text: Tower chests draw from Illager, mining, library, and rare tower loot. Valuable finds can include diamonds, enchanted equipment, and golden apples.
